response.description: A top-down watercolor-style desk scene on warm cream paper. An open blue-bound ledger at left has rows of colored squares and short gray lines. Two large rounded cream index cards sit in the middle, one with a blue tab and square and one with a green tab and square. A curved dashed blue line with arrowheads links a blue ledger row to the upper card. At right, a sheet held by a green binder clip shows two green check marks in boxes and gray placeholder lines. Ceramic dishes of small blue and green square tiles, leafy stems in a pale vessel, dark pencils, and cropped books surround the papers. Muted blue, sage green, warm ivory, soft shadows, and orderly spacing give the composition a quiet, tidy appearance. No readable words or people are visible.

response.reconstructed_prompt: Create a wide landscape watercolor and colored-pencil illustration of an orderly desk viewed directly from above. Use textured ivory paper, muted slate blue, sage green, soft graphite lines, and gentle daylight shadows. On the left place a cropped open blue-bound ledger with a ruled table, eight colored square swatches, and abstract gray text lines. In the center stack two separate cream rounded index cards vertically, each divided into simple fields with gray placeholder lines; give the top card a blue tab and blue square and the bottom card a sage tab and green square. Connect a blue ledger row and the top card with a curved dashed blue line with arrowheads at both ends. On the right put a slightly angled cream checklist held by a green metal binder clip, with two large green checked boxes and abstract lines. Frame the desk with cropped ceramic bowls containing blue and green square tiles, olive-like leafy stems in a pale vessel at upper left, dark wooden pencils below, and books at lower right. Keep all lettering illegible and the scene softly painted, calm, spacious, and tactile. This is a plausible recreation prompt, not recovered original wording.
